d: For years, studying abroad was considered one of the most reliable pathways to better jobs and global opportunities. But that is changing. A weakening rupee, tougher visa rules, uncertain job prospects and rising education costs are forcing many Indian students and families to rethink whether a foreign degree is still worth the investment. While traditional destinations like the United States and the United Kingdom are seeing declining enrolments, countries such as Germany, Italy and Ireland are emerging as attractive alternatives.
